commands:
set -e
BUILD=/tmp/mem-alloc-build
rm -rf "$BUILD"
cat > /tmp/mem_alloc_inject.cmake <<'CMK'
find_path(CMOCKA_INCLUDE_DIR cmocka.h)
find_library(CMOCKA_LIB NAMES cmocka)
if(NOT CMOCKA_INCLUDE_DIR OR NOT CMOCKA_LIB)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "cmocka not found")
endif()
if(NOT TARGET cmocka::cmocka)
  add_library(cmocka::cmocka UNKNOWN IMPORTED)
  set_target_properties(cmocka::cmocka PROPERTIES IMPORTED_LOCATION "${CMOCKA_LIB}" INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${CMOCKA_INCLUDE_DIR}")
endif()
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS} -include stdarg.h -include stddef.h -include setjmp.h")
CMK
cmake -S tests/unit/mem-alloc -B "$BUILD" -DWAMR_BUILD_PLATFORM=linux -DLLVM_DIR=IGNORE -DCMAKE_PROJECT_test-mem-alloc_INCLUDE=/tmp/mem_alloc_inject.cmake
cmake --build "$BUILD" -j"$(nproc)"
set +e
CMOCKA_MESSAGE_OUTPUT=STDOUT "$BUILD/mem-alloc-test"
CMOCKA_MESSAGE_OUTPUT=STDOUT "$BUILD/mem-alloc-gc-test"
